verdict.rationale: Kong's docs host a directory of OpenAPI specifications for its own APIs (developer.konghq.com/api/), which delivers the core of the story: a machine-readable spec of Kong's APIs. The probe got 404s at conventional paths like /openapi.json, but that only shows the specs aren't at well-known locations, not that they are missing. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a direct download link or format details per API, specs at well-known or auto-discoverable paths, independent or hands-on confirmation of downloading a spec.
